title: [P2] Board shape drift: 84 distinct row shapes on one board — declare a canonical schema
reasoning: Measured while reshaing a row: the tasks.jsonl board carries 84 distinct key sets across 323 rows (the largest single shape covers 8 rows). boardctl validates OK because it checks ids, statuses and result vocabulary — not key uniformity — so nothing ever flags this. The consequence is item 2's real residue: rows cannot be aligned or compared field-by-field, and a consumer that reads one field sees it present on some rows and absent on others. Fix: declare the canonical key set (the 31-key majority shape is the natural candidate), add a uniformity check to boardctl so drift fails validation, then reshape the outliers with line surgery and a semantic diff — exactly the repair done on my-project and bunker.
review_notes: Filed by the review programme 2026-09-23 while correcting a row shape on this board.
